title: Molwetse
intro: Bogologolo tala, mo metlheng ya ntlhantlha ya hisitori ya motho, meya e mebedi e ne e eme fa pele ga Mmopi wa yone e tshwere ditshupelo. E nngwe e ne ya amogelwa, e nngwe ya se ka ya amogelwa. Se se neng sa latela se ne se tla nna masetlapelo a ntlha a magolo fa gare ga bana ba motho - tiro e le nngwe ya go ikgapa ka bopelotelele le tiro e le nngwe ya go ipusolosetsa ka tsela e e botlhoko. A o ka ribolola gore ke mang?
clues: Ke tshotswe mo malatsing a ntlha fela a botshelo jwa motho mo lefatsheng
Ke ne ke le ngwana wa para ya ntlha ya batho ba ba kileng ba tsamaya mo lefatsheng leno
Ke kile ka ntsha setlhabelo sa letsomane la me le le gaisang go itumedisa Mmopi wa me .
Tshupelo ya me e ne ya amogelwa go tswa kwa godimo, fa tshupelo ya ga ngwanake yone e ne ya ganwa .
Fa ke ne ke tshosediwa ka loso, ke ne ka tlhopha gore ke se ka ka tsholetsa letsogo la me kgatlhanong le ngwanake .
Ke ne ka nna motho wa ntlha mo hisitoring yotlhe ya batho go bolawa ke motho yo mongwe ka phoso

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
